title: Early Experience: Data Construction + Dual-Branch Training (IWM & SR)

nodes.label: Expert Dataset D_expert
nodes.semantic_desc: Collection of expert demonstrations D_expert={(s_i,a_i)}; provides expert states and corresponding expert actions to seed rollout construction and to supervise policy learning.
nodes.visual_desc: A stacked-dataset icon (three offset sheets) labeled 'D_expert' with two columns 's' and 'a' shown as tiny glyphs (state circle, action arrow).

nodes.label: Expert State s_i
nodes.semantic_desc: A single expert state extracted from D_expert; used as context for sampling alternative actions and for reflection comparisons.
nodes.visual_desc: A small rounded card showing a generic state token sequence (tiny squares) and a circle glyph 's_i' (no detailed text).

nodes.label: Initial LLM Policy π0
nodes.semantic_desc: Starting language-model policy used to condition on s_i and sample candidate actions; outputs action candidates and later is updated by IWM/SR training.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle module with label 'LLM Policy π0' and a small transformer block icon (stacked layers) in the corner.

nodes.label: K Alternative Actions
nodes.semantic_desc: Non-expert candidate action set {a_i^1…a_i^K} sampled from the initial policy conditioned on s_i; used for environment rollouts and reflection generation.
nodes.visual_desc: A fan-out of K small arrow tokens (a^1, a^2, …, a^K) as minimalist arrows arranged in a row; no detailed text.

nodes.label: Environment Simulator
nodes.semantic_desc: Execution environment; takes (state, action) and produces next/future state outcomes used as supervision signals for rollout and comparison.
nodes.visual_desc: A rounded rectangle labeled 'Env' with a small grid-world/physics icon (simple cube + trajectory curve).

nodes.label: Expert Next State s_{i+1}
nodes.semantic_desc: Future state obtained by executing expert action a_i in the environment from s_i; serves as reference outcome for self-reflection comparisons.
nodes.visual_desc: A single state card labeled 's_{i+1}' represented by a circle glyph and a short dotted trajectory from s_i.

nodes.label: Alt Next States s_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Set of future states produced by executing each alternative action a_i^j from s_i; used as supervision targets in IWM and as contrastive outcomes in SR.
nodes.visual_desc: A bundle of small state cards (multiple circles) with tiny superscripts j and diverging mini-trajectories indicating different rollouts.

nodes.label: Rollout Dataset D_rollout
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed triplets D_rollout={(s_i,a_i^j,s_i^j)}; provides (state, candidate action) inputs and corresponding future-state targets (reward-free supervision).
nodes.visual_desc: A stacked-dataset icon labeled 'D_rollout' with three tiny columns marked by glyphs: state circle, action arrow, future-state circle.

nodes.label: IWM Branch
nodes.semantic_desc: Implicit World Modeling training branch; takes (s_i,a_i^j) from D_rollout and trains the policy to predict future state s_i^j as a next-token prediction problem.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'IWM (Implicit World Modeling)' with a small timeline/transition icon: s → a → s'.

nodes.label: Future-State Tokens
nodes.semantic_desc: Tokenized representation of predicted future state; output target/prediction space used by IWM to internalize environment dynamics.
nodes.visual_desc: A short strip of discrete tokens (small squares) ending with a highlighted last token to suggest next-token prediction.

nodes.label: NLL Dynamics Loss
nodes.semantic_desc: Negative log-likelihood loss computed between predicted and target future-state tokens; provides optimization signal for IWM training.
nodes.visual_desc: A small loss node with a curve icon (decreasing loss line) and label 'NLL' inside a compact pill shape.

nodes.label: SR Branch
nodes.semantic_desc: Self-Reflection branch; takes s_i plus outcome comparison (expert next state vs alternative next states) and generates natural-language explanations c_i^j stating why expert action is better.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle labeled 'SR (Self-Reflection)' with a split-compare icon: two small trajectories merging into a text bubble.

nodes.label: Reflection Text c_i^j
nodes.semantic_desc: Natural-language critique/explanation generated for each alternative action; used as supervised target to teach the policy self-reflective reasoning.
nodes.visual_desc: A speech bubble containing 2–3 gray text lines (no readable words) and a small warning/check glyph pair to suggest preference judgment.

nodes.label: Reflection Dataset D_refl
nodes.semantic_desc: Constructed reflection pairs D_refl={(s_i,a_i^j,c_i^j)}; provides supervision for generating self-reflection text conditioned on state and candidate action.
nodes.visual_desc: A stacked-dataset icon labeled 'D_refl' with three glyph-columns: state circle, action arrow, speech bubble.

nodes.label: Joint Policy Training
nodes.semantic_desc: Unified optimization stage that trains the LLM policy on both expert action prediction (from D_expert) and reflection generation (from D_refl), integrating IL-style action supervision with SR signals.
nodes.visual_desc: Large rounded rectangle labeled 'Joint Training (IL + SR)' with two incoming mini-icons (action arrow, speech bubble) inside the box.

nodes.label: Updated LLM Policy π
nodes.semantic_desc: Final trained policy after Early Experience; outputs actions and (optionally) self-reflection text, with dynamics awareness learned via IWM and preference reasoning via SR.
nodes.visual_desc: Rounded rectangle with bold border labeled 'LLM Policy π' and a small checkmark badge indicating updated/learned policy.
